summary: Frontend-only verification of the Checkout Back-button navigation fix. All 3 scenarios PASS. (1) PRIMARY BUG: Settings → click upgrade-pro_monthly-btn → navigates to /checkout?plan=pro_monthly&from=/settings; back-btn label is 'Back to settings' and clicking it returns to /settings. (2) REGRESSION /choose-plan: purchase-btn → /checkout?plan=pro_monthly (no from param); back-btn label 'Back'; clicking returns to /choose-plan. (3) REGRESSION landing pricing: pricing-cta-essential → /checkout?plan=essential_monthly (no from); back-btn returns to /choose-plan (default fallback).
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout backTo logic (searchParams.get('from')?.startsWith('/')) correctly protects against open-redirect via absolute URLs — good.

Bundle size ~12MB in dev — page initially blank for ~30-60s while bundle loads; consider code-splitting non-critical routes for faster TTI. Not part of this bug but was a testing friction point (bundle takes long enough that wait_for_function was required).
test_credentials: testpro@test.com / password (auth flow: /auth?mode=login → 'Continue with Email' → email/password form)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route is /auth?mode=login (not /login). User must click 'Continue with Email' button before the email/password inputs render. Bundle is large (~12MB dev bundle) — use page.wait_for_function("document.getElementById('root')?.children.length > 0", timeout=60000) after every page.goto instead of relying on wait_for_load_state('networkidle'). Termly cookie banner overlays the footer; dismiss with 'Accept'. testpro user is enterprise_monthly so enterprise upgrade button is disabled; use pro_monthly or essential_monthly for upgrade tests.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Checkout page hardcoded navigate('/choose-plan') on Back click. Fix (already applied by main agent): Settings.handleUpgrade now sends `from=/settings` via query string; Checkout reads `from` param, validates it starts with '/', and uses it as backTo (defaulting to /choose-plan). Back label switches to 'Back to settings' when from=/settings. All verified working end-to-end via UI.
